text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports; If the applicant is a Chinese citizen who has immigrated to a foreign country, the application will be strictly reviewed in accordance with the "Higher Education Quality Standards for International Students Studying in China (Trial Implementation)"; 2. In good health, between 18 and 25 years old; for applicants pursuing a master's degree, the age limit can be appropriately relaxed; 3. No criminal record, willing to abide by the laws, regulations, and relevant management regulations of the People's Republic of China and our university; 4. Have a high school diploma or above; applicants for postgraduate studies must have a bachelor's degree or above; 5. For applicants of English-taught majors, the high school graduation exam total score should be at least B level (score 60%-70%) or above, with an English subject score of at least 65% of the full score, or an IELTS certificate with a score of 6.5 or above.
